entries.question: Kgmu se bsc nursing kaise kare in hindi
entries.answer:
KGMU (King George's Medical University) se B.Sc. Nursing karne ke liye, aapko pehle **Paramedical Admission** ki prakriya se guzarana hoga. Yeh pravesh pariksha dwara hota hai.

Aapko KGMU ki adhikarik website par **Paramedical Admission** se sambandhit jaankari aur nirdeshon ko dekhna chahiye. Yeh jankari aamtaur par admission season ke dauran website ke homepage ya ek alag section mein uplabdh hoti hai.

Niche kuch mahatvapurna kadam diye gaye hain jinhe aap follow kar sakte hain:

1.  **KGMU ki Website Check Karein:** Sabse pehle, KGMU ki adhikarik website [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) par jaayein.
2.  **Admission Section Khojein:** Website par "Admissions" ya "Courses/Admission" section dhoondhein. Yahan aapko B.Sc. Nursing jaise paramedical courses ke baare mein jaankari milegi.
3.  **Eligibility Criteria Dekhein:** Pravesh ke liye yogyata maapdand (eligibility criteria) jaise ki umar, shaikshik yogyata (10+2 mein science stream saath mein biology) aadi ko dhyan se padhein.
4.  **Application Form Bharein:** Jab admission notification jari ho, to online application form bharein. Iske liye aapko nirdharit shulk (fee) bhi dena hoga.
5.  **Pravesh Pariksha (Entrance Exam) ki Taiyari Karein:** B.Sc. Nursing ke liye ek pravesh pariksha hoti hai. Is pariksha ke syllabus aur pattern ko samajhne ke liye website par uplabdh material ka upyog karein.
6.  **Counseling Prakriya:** Pravesh pariksha mein safal hone ke baad, aapko counseling prakriya mein bhag lena hoga jahan aapko B.Sc. Nursing course ke liye seat mil sakti hai.

Naye admission process aur dates ke liye website par "Paramedical Admission" section ya "Notice Board" ko regular check karna mahatvapurna hai.

Agar aapko koi khaas jankari chahiye, toh pooch sakte hain.

entries.question: Paramedical nhi nursing krna hai up cnet bsc nursing
entries.answer:
KGMU se B.Sc. Nursing karne ke liye, upar bataye gaye paramedical admission process ko hi follow karna hoga, kyunki B.Sc. Nursing bhi paramedical courses ke antargat hi aata hai.

UP NEET UG (Uttar Pradesh National Eligibility cum Entrance Test Undergraduate) ke dwara KGMU mein B.Sc. Nursing mein pravesh ke liye alag se koi exam nahi hota hai. Pravesh mukhyatah KGMU dwara ayojit **Paramedical Entrance Examination** ke dwara hi hota hai, ya phir UP State Entrance Exam ke through hota hai.

Yani, aapko **KGMU ki adhikarik website par "Paramedical Admission" section ko hi follow karna hoga** jahan B.Sc. Nursing ke liye pravesh prakriya ki jaankari di jaati hai.

Yahan kuch mahatvapurna baatein hain jo aapko pata honi chahiye:

*   **KGMU Website:** Sabse sahi aur navintam jaankari ke liye, KGMU ki official website ([www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org)) ko niyamit roop se dekhte rahein. Admission notification, eligibility criteria, application process, syllabus aur counseling dates sabhi vahan milenge.
*   **Paramedical Entrance Exam:** B.Sc. Nursing mein pravesh ke liye KGMU ek entrance exam conduct karta hai. Is pariksha ki taiyari ke liye website par diye gaye syllabus ko dekhein.
*   **UP NEET UG:** Kuch seats UP NEET UG ke through bhi bhari ja sakti hain, lekin B.Sc. Nursing ke liye KGMU ka apna alag entrance exam hota hai. UP NEET UG ka syllabus MBBS/BDS ke liye hota hai, jo B.Sc. Nursing ke liye alag ho sakta hai. Isliye KGMU ki website par di gayi jaankari hi sabse vishvasniya hogi.

Agar aapko admission process ke kisi khaas charan ke baare mein jaanna hai, toh pooch sakte hain.

entries.question: Kgmu non teaching post documents verification is on same date with the Aiims CRE national level exam what should students do many are suffering
entries.answer:
I understand you're facing a scheduling conflict with the KGMU non-teaching post document verification and the AIIMS CRE national level exam. This is a difficult situation for many students.

To address this, I recommend the following:

1.  **Contact KGMU Directly:** The most effective way to resolve this is to reach out to the KGMU administration responsible for the document verification process. You can try contacting them through the following:
    *   **Important Contact Numbers:** The KGMU website provides a list of important contact numbers, including the Registrar Office and Help Line. You can find these here: [https://www.kgmu.org/imp_numbers.php](https://www.kgmu.org/imp_numbers.php)
    *   **PRO Offices:** The PRO offices also have contact numbers that might be able to assist or direct you to the right department: [https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php](https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php)
    *   **Examination Controller:** If the verification is related to an examination process, the Controller of Examination's office might be the appropriate contact. You can find their details here: [https://www.kgmu.org/controller_of_examination.php](https://www.kgmu.org/controller_of_examination.php)

2.  **Explain the Situation Clearly:** When you contact KGMU, clearly explain the situation:
    *   State that the KGMU document verification date clashes with the AIIMS CRE national level exam.
    *   Mention that many students are affected by this conflict.
    *   Politely request if there is any possibility of rescheduling the KGMU document verification or if an alternative arrangement can be made for students facing this conflict.

3.  **Gather Evidence (if possible):** If you have any official communication or admit cards from both KGMU and AIIMS that clearly show the conflicting dates, have them ready to present.

I hope this helps you and other affected students find a resolution.
